integrity: The proof is analytic. A packaged symbolic checker verifies the algebraic defect identities; endpoint rigidity is proved separately from compact invariance and hyperbolicity of the affine branches. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem controls first moments of compactly supported invariant probabilities but does not identify a physical measure, compute an invariant density, or classify the attractor. The 1978 foundational article was not available as inspected full text; later same-map sources independently verify the map normalization and fixed-point formulas.
title: A fixed-point barycenter interval for stationary Lozi dynamics
